title: Lokalized generated CLDR conformance vectors
description: The expanded CLDR plural conformance corpus generated by CldrDataGenerator. Every implementation's cardinal and ordinal selectors are gated on it. Serialized as RFC 8785 JCS.
$comment: Plan v7 sections 5.2 and 8.1. This is deliberately NOT the display-example corpus in cldr-plural-data.json, whose samplesFor() drops compact-exponent tokens and keeps only the endpoints of sample ranges. Gating on the display corpus would leave the modulo rules and the c/e operands untested.

items.$comment: start and end are plural categories, not numbers. Lokalized selects a range category from the pair of endpoint categories; Intl.PluralRules#selectRange takes two numbers and is not a substitute.

items.description: A locale tag the enclosing group applies to.

sample.$comment: A decimal literal, optionally with a compact exponent suffix such as 1000000c6. Trailing zeros are significant: '1.0' and '1' are different operands and must not be normalized. The pattern deliberately admits the compact form, whose absence from the display corpus is the reason this artifact exists.

condition.$comment: The CLDR rule condition. Empty for a catch-all `other` rule, so no minLength is asserted.

samples.$comment: Expanded: sample-range interiors are enumerated, not reduced to endpoints.
